meta.name: Erotic And Wacky Tunnel Of Time 1983
meta.description:
A nerd working in his home creates a time machine that sends him back to various eras where apparently there are women just waiting for some time traveler to have sex with. We are not talking about a plot driven movie here and there are more than a few anachronisms. Still that is not why anyone would want to watch this movie.
Resolution is okay, there is a logo burned in and I could not find subtitles.
